coordinate_system.origin: cabinet front-left-bottom unless an INTERFACE datum says otherwise

interface.notes: External interfaces mate when their standards are compatible and their KEY values match. Internal interfaces use KEY as a reproducible geometry signature.

keepout.notes: A keepout reserves space for its OWNER interface. Features owned by other interfaces should not intersect it.

feature.shape: axis_aligned_bounding_box plus exact circle/rectangle face primitive
feature.notes: V2 emits every active hole, blind pocket, and carcass joint on both outer cabinet side panels in verbose mode. Circle features include CY/CZ/R for exact collision tests; rectangular features use their Y/Z bounds.

coverage.notes: A clean report must be interpreted with these scope records. The Python geometry audit completes final CUT/POCKET contour coverage; neither layer claims structural/load or CAM verification.

module.notes: Module-local envelope metadata used by the MORG-1 resolver and conservative project collision checks.

interface_frame.notes: Module-local mating frame: O is origin, U/V are in-plane reference axes, N is outward normal.

MOI-STACK-1.compatibility: male and female interfaces require the same generated KEY

MOI-GANG-1.compatibility: left/right peer interfaces require the same generated KEY
MOI-GANG-1.geometry_note: V2 signs both placement and machining dimensions. Different dowel diameters/depths or connector diameters are incompatible even when centers match.

MOI-JOINT-1.compatibility: mating part features within one assembly use the same semantic location resolver and generated KEY

MOI-DRAWER-1.compatibility: drawer corner parts in one assembly use the same generated KEY

keepout_policy.enforce: conflicts emitted by the common feature-vs-keepout validator are CHECK|ERROR records
keepout_policy.warn_only: the same conflicts are CHECK|WARN records
keepout_policy.off: interface-owned keepout validation is disabled; geometry is not altered

supersedes.reason: adds project composition graph and explicit interface frames while retaining v2 validation coverage

relationship_types.mate: Requires compatible external STANDARD/ROLE/KEY and aligns INTERFACE_FRAME records.
relationship_types.contains: Places a child at a parent-local offset; overlap is intentional and exempt from module-envelope collision errors.

derived_module_types.span_worktop: Computes a worktop envelope across already-resolved support modules with explicit overhangs and support-height validation.

project_composition.placement_scope_v3: translation plus orthogonal Z rotations (0/90/180/270); arbitrary 3-D rotation is not claimed
project_composition.project_collision_scope_v3: conservative module AABB overlap check; manufacturing geometry remains validated per OpenSCAD module and exhaustive validator
